posts.title: I connected my Withings Body+ to Home Assistant with an ESP32
posts.description: My Withings scale now sends weight and body composition data directly to Home Assistant through an ESP32, without going through the Withings cloud.

posts.title: The app blocker I made because I kept cheating on Screen Time
posts.description: I kept skipping my Screen Time limits and did not want to spend €50 on an NFC blocker, so I made my own.

posts.title: How a bus queue became a BBK Live festival app
posts.description: I messaged Hermes from a Telegram group while waiting for the bus. By the end of BBK Live, the timetable had become a PWA with Spotify, a map, and an estimated wristband balance.
